1437 F
SHANGHAI 11.1437-F(1)
Foreign ~
No. 1437 F (1)
Date 27 / 6 / 42

PROVISIONAL REGULATIONS GOVERNING THE INSTITUTION OF THE
PAO CHIA SYSTEM IN THE INTERNATIONAL SETTLEMENT, THE TAKING OF A
CENSUS, AND THE ISSUING OF CIVIL IDENTITY CERTIFICATES BY
THE SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

Article 1. - For the purpose of taking a census and eliminating
acts of terrorism and maintaining peace and order,
the Shanghai Municipal Police promulgate these
PROVISIONAL REGULATIONS governing the institution
of the PAO CHIA SYSTEM in the International Settlement, the
taking of a census and the issuing of CIVIL IDENTITY
CERTIFICATES which will be conducted under the
direction of the Police.

Article 2. - All foreign nationals living in the International
Settlement must comply with the PAO CHIA SYSTEM.

Article 3. - The PAO CHIA DISTRICTS will be divided according
to Police Districts.

“A” Division
Central Pao Chia District
Nanking Road Pao Chia District
Chengtu Road Pao Chia District

“B” Division
Ginza Pao Chia District
Bubbling Well Pao Chia District
Gordon Road Pao Chia District
Pootoo Road Pao Chia District

“C” Division
Hongkew Pao Chia District
West Hongkew Pao Chia District
Kuching Road Pao Chia District
Maxwell Road Pao Chia District

“D” Division
Wayside Pao Chia District
Tulin Road Pao Chia District
Yangtsepoo Pao Chia District

Article 4. - The PAO CHIA SYSTEM as regards foreign residents
of the International Settlement will be enforced
through the “FOREIGN SECTION OF THE PAO CHIA
OFFICE” which will be set up by the Municipal
Police.

Article 5. - For purpose of the PAO CHIA SYSTEM, all foreign
residents are divided into (1) families and (2)
individual men and women residents in the
absence of any family.

Article 6. - In accordance with the Principles of the PAO CHIA
SYSTEM each foreign family and single foreign
male or female person must secure the signature
of the head of the other families or of the
single male and female persons.

**〔此处转录不清〕**
pages.zh:
1437 F
上海 11.1437-F(1)
外籍 ~
第 1437 F (1) 号
日期 1942年6月27日

上海公共租界工部局警务处关于在国际租界实施保甲制度、进行人口普查以及签发民用身份证的暂行条例。

第一条. - 为了进行人口普查，消除恐怖行为并维持治安秩序，上海公共租界工部局警务处颁布本暂行条例，以规范在国际租界实施保甲制度、进行人口普查及签发民用身份证事宜，上述工作将在警务处的指导下进行。

第二条. - 所有居住在国际租界的外国国民必须遵守保甲制度。

第三条. - 保甲区将按警区划分。

“A” 分区
中央保甲区
南京路保甲区
成都路保甲区

“B” 分区
静安寺路（Ginza）保甲区
跑马厅路（Bubbling Well）保甲区
戈登路保甲区
普陀路保甲区

“C” 分区
虹口保甲区
西虹口保甲区
古晋路保甲区
麦克斯韦尔路保甲区

“D” 分区
韦尔斯桥（Wayside）保甲区
杜林路保甲区
杨树浦保甲区

第四条. - 针对国际租界外籍居民的保甲制度，将通过由工部局警务处设立的“保甲办公处外籍股”来执行。

第五条. - 就保甲制度而言，所有外籍居民分为（1）家庭户，以及（2）无家庭户的个人男女居民。

第六条. - 根据保甲制度原则，每个外籍家庭和单身外籍男女必须取得其他家庭户主或单身男女居民的签名。

**〔此处转录不清〕**
